components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. A leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits. For example '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9()+.\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid
            for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored
            and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When present it is used to
            derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate. Accepted and returned
            in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, declares this owner a deliberate member of an existing
            household and bypasses the household duplicate block, allowing creation even though
            another owner already shares the same lastName and postcode (the household key).
            Otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict. A declared member is created
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, as the recognized
                country code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes from the left and separated by spaces. For example the stored
                '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' stays in
                E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased
                first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
                assigned at creation, equal to one more than the number of owners already in that
                city.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household.
                The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode) and is the first 12 hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest over the normalized lastName (case-insensitive, collapsed
                whitespace) joined to the postcode by '|', so any two owners sharing a lastName and
                postcode automatically receive the same value. Absent for owners without a postcode,
                which belong to no shared household.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A1B0C9D8E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formed as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where telephone is the normalized E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when the owner has no email)
                and householdId is the shared household identifier (empty when the owner shares
                no household). Hard duplicate detection is keyed on the household, so two owners
                sharing a lastName and postcode are the same household, and a second such owner
                is rejected with 409 Conflict unless it sets sharesHousehold.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared the same firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created,
                not counting this owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starts at 1,
                is increased by 1 when an email is present and by 1 when namesakeCount is 0, and is
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when
                65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard household duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's lastName (compared case-insensitively) and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise false. An owner that declared its household via
                sharesHousehold is a deliberate member and is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of,
                set when possibleDuplicate is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
